answer: Tie each agent's economic identity to a costly stake rather than a free username. Think of reputation as a pigment that only deepens with real work: a new identity starts pale, and only attested contributions darken it into trust. A sybil swarm, by contrast, blows through like a zephyr - many light, short-lived accounts that never build enough history to carry weight. Capping rewards per identity and requiring a plume of proven attestations before an agent can vote or withdraw makes mass forgery unprofitable, because each fake must pay the same price as a real one.
